questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of Ram and Shyam is 3 : 4, and 4 years ago the ratio was 2 : 3. What will be the ratio of the ages of Ram and Shyam 4 years from now?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Current age ratio of Ram and Shyam = 3 : 4.

Age ratio 4 years ago = 2 : 3.

**Formula Used:**

The ratio of ages can be calculated using the relationship:

Current age = Age a few years ago + Number of years passed.

**Calculation:**

Let Ram's current age be 3x and Shyam's current age be 4x.

Four years ago, ages were:

Ram's age = 3x - 4 and Shyam's age = 4x - 4.

The given ratio 4 years ago was 2 : 3, hence:

(3x - 4) / (4x - 4) = 2 / 3.

9x - 12 = 8x - 8.

9x - 8x = -8 + 12.

x = 4.

Therefore, Ram's current age = 3x = 12 years, and Shyam's current age = 4x = 16 years.

To find their ages 4 years from now:

Ram's age in 4 years = 12 + 4 = 16 years.

Shyam's age in 4 years = 16 + 4 = 20 years.

The ratio of their ages 4 years from now:

16 : 20 = 4 : 5.

**Therefore, the ratio of the ages of Ram and Shyam 4 years from now will be 4 : 5.**

questions.question: The ratio of ages of two students is 5 ∶ 4. The difference between their ages is 8 years. What is the age of the younger student?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Age ratio = 5 ∶ 4

Age difference = 8 years

Find younger student's age

**Concept: **

Ratio of two quantities of the same kind and in the same units is a fraction that shows how many times the one quantity is of the other.

**Solution:**

Difference in ratio = 5 - 4 = 1

Age corresponding to 1 part in ratio = Age difference = 8 years

Younger student's age = 4 parts in ratio × Age corresponding to 1 part in ratio = 4 × 8 = 32 years

**Hence, the age of the younger student is 32 years (Option 2).**

The total age of the girl and her parents six years ago was 2x + 2x - 3 + x - 6 = 96 years

5x = 96 + 9 

5x = 105 

x = 21

The present age of mother will be 39 + 6 = 45 years

questions.question: Three years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 29 years. If the average age of B and C, 5 years ago, was 23 years, then what is the present age (in years) of A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present average of A, B, and C = 29 + 3 = 32 years.

Present sum of ages of A, B, and C = 32 × 3 = 96 years.

Present average of B and C = 23 + 5 = 28 years.

Present sum of ages of B and C = 28 × 2 = 56 years.

Present age of A = 96 − 56 = 40 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of A, B, and C, 3 years ago = 29 years

Average age of B and C, 5 years ago = 23 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of ages = Average age × Number of persons

 Present Age Sum Distribution
 
 
 Sum of Present Ages of A, B, C = 96
 
 
• 
 

 
 
 Sum of B, C = 56
 
 
 Age of A = 40
 
 +

 A = 96 − 56 = 40 years

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ages of A, B, and C (3 years ago) = 29 × 3 = 87 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of A, B, and C = 87 + (3 persons × 3 years) = 87 + 9 = 96 years

⇒ Sum of ages of B and C (5 years ago) = 23 × 2 = 46 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of B and C = 46 + (2 persons × 5 years) = 46 + 10 = 56 years

⇒ Present age of A = (Present sum of A, B, and C) − (Present sum of B and C)

⇒ Present age of A = 96 − 56 = 40 years

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Change in Average

If every individual value in a group increases by 'k' years (like aging), then the average of the group also increases by exactly 'k' years.

Combined Group Value

The sum of elements in a larger group minus the sum of elements in its subset will always yield the sum of the remaining uncounted elements.

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of any two persons remains constant throughout their lifetime, regardless of past or future progression.
</p

questions.question: Four years ago, the average age of a group of five members was 38 years. One more man joins the group and the present average age of the group members becomes 44 years. What is the present age (in years) of the new member?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present average age of the 5 members = 38 + 4 = 42 years.

New average age of the 6 members = 44 years.

Age of new member = New Average + Old Members × Increase in Average

Age of new member = 44 + 5 × (44 − 42)

Age of new member = 44 + 10 = 54 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average age of 5 members 4 years ago = 38 years

⇒ Present average age of 6 members (with new member) = 44 years

 Present Ages Representation
 
 5 Members' Present Age = 210
 
 
 5 Members' Present Age = 210
 New: 54
 

 Total 6 Members' Present Age = 264

**Calculations:**

⇒ Present average age of the initial 5 members = 38 + 4 = 42 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of these 5 members = 5 × 42 = 210 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of all 6 members = 6 × 44 = 264 years

⇒ Present age of the new member = 264 − 210 = 54 years

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Concept of Age Progression

If the average age of a group is A years, then after t years, the average age of the same group becomes A + t years, provided no members are added or removed.

Inclusion of a New Member

Age of new member = New Average + Old Number of Members × Change in Average.

Weighted Average

When two groups with n₁ and n₂ members and averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, the combined average is (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: In a joint family of 16 persons, the eldest and the youngest members have an age difference of 82 years. If these two are left out of the counting, then the average age of the remaining 14 persons is 28. The average age of the entire family being 30, what is the age of the eldest person?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference of an age of the eldest and youngest members = 82 years

The average age of remaining 14 persons = 28

The average age of the entire family = 30

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the age of eldest and youngest be x and y respectively

The difference of an age of the eldest and youngest members = 82 years

⇒ (x – y) = 82 ....(1)

Now,

The average age of remaining 14 persons = (14 × 28) = 392

The average age of the entire family = (16 × 30) = 480

The age of the eldest and youngest family = (480 – 392) = 88

So,

(x + y) = 88 ....(2)

Now,

Adding equation (1) and (2), we get 

⇒ (x – y) = 82 + (x + y) = 88

⇒ 2x = (88 + 82)

⇒ 2x = 170

⇒ x = 85 years

**∴ The age of the eldest person is 85 years**

questions.question: Five years from now, the ratio of the ages of A, B and C will be 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 2. The sum of the squares of their present ages is 525. What is the present age of B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let's use the option verification method to find B's present age.

If B's present age = 20 years, his age after 5 years = 25 years.

Since the future ratio A : B : C = 3 : 5 : 2, the common multiplier is 25 ÷ 5 = 5.

Present ages of A and C will be (15 − 5) = 10 years and (10 − 5) = 5 years respectively.

Sum of squares = 10² + 20² + 5² = 100 + 400 + 25 = 525 (Matches the given sum perfectly).

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of the ages of A, B, and C after 5 years = 3 : 5 : 2

Sum of the squares of their present ages = 525

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ab4f153fc297e5bd286bc787fb04095be5bb8d4cf5d7ef99c78518718f84557.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the ages of A, B, and C after 5 years be 3x, 5x, and 2x respectively.

⇒ Present age of A = (3x − 5)

⇒ Present age of B = (5x − 5)

⇒ Present age of C = (2x − 5)

According to the given condition, the sum of their present age squares is 525:

⇒ (3x − 5)² + (5x − 5)² + (2x − 5)² = 525

⇒ (9x² − 30x + 25) + (25x² − 50x + 25) + (4x² − 20x + 25) = 525

⇒ 38x² − 100x + 75 = 525

⇒ 38x² − 100x − 450 = 0

Dividing the entire equation by 2:

⇒ 19x² − 50x − 225 = 0

⇒ 19x² − 95x + 45x − 225 = 0

⇒ 19x(x − 5) + 45(x − 5) = 0

⇒ (19x + 45)(x − 5) = 0

Since age cannot be a negative value, x = 5.

⇒ Present age of B = 5x − 5

⇒ Present age of B = 5 × 5 − 5 = 20 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Multiplier

When a ratio like a : b : c is given, the actual quantities can be calculated by assuming a common variable (ax, bx, cx).

Quadratic Roots Formula

The roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 can also be calculated using the quadratic formula: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a.

Ages Rule

If the present age is x, then the age n years ago was (x − n) and the age n years from now will be (x + n).
</p

questions.solution:

Elimination method of linear equation in two variable

Then, 4 years ago, x - 4 = 3 × (y - 4)...(1)

And one year ago, x - 1 = 2 × (y - 1) ...(2)

Subtracting (2) from (1),

- 3 = y - 10

y = 7 

Substituting y = 7 in (1),

x = 3 × (7 - 4) + 4 = 13 

**∴ The difference between the ages of Garvit and Yuvansh is 13 - 7 = 6 years.**

questions.question: The present ages of Vishal and Shekhar are in the ratio of 14 ∶ 17. Six years from now, their ages will be in the ratio of 17 ∶ 20. What is Shekhar's present age?
questions.solution:

Ratio of ages after six years = 17 : 20

Let the present age of Vishal be 14x and Shekhar be 17x.

After six years,

Age of Vishal = 14x + 6

Age of Shekhar = 17x + 6

According to the question,

⇒ (14x+6)/(17x+6)=(17)/(20)

⇒ 20 × (14x + 6) = 17 × (17x + 6)

⇒ 280x + 120 = 289x + 102

⇒ 289x – 280x = 120 – 102

⇒ 9x = 18

⇒ x = (18)/(9) = 2

So, shekhar's present age = 17x = 17 × 2 = 34 years

**Hence, the present age of Shekhar is 34 years.**

questions.question: After 4 years, Ramesh's age will be 50% more than what his age was 16 years ago. What is his present age?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Age (after 4 years) to Age (16 years ago) = 150% : 100% = 3 : 2.

Total time gap between the two periods = 4 + 16 = 20 years.

Difference in ratio parts = 3 − 2 = 1 part.

1 part = 20 years ⇒ Age 16 years ago (2 parts) = 20 × 2 = 40 years.

Present age = 40 + 16 = 56 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 56 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

After 4 years, Ramesh's age will be 50% more than what his age was 16 years ago.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f529f6312b6cd3a676c516157317e4d29ce5fbf15a9fb3fd82d98607e0208b73.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the present age of Ramesh be x years.

⇒ Ramesh's age 16 years ago = (x − 16) years

⇒ Ramesh's age after 4 years = (x + 4) years

⇒ Age after 4 years = Age 16 years ago + 50% of Age 16 years ago

⇒ x + 4 = 1.5 × (x − 16)

⇒ x + 4 = 1.5x − 24

⇒ 1.5x − x = 24 + 4

⇒ 0.5x = 28

⇒ x = 28 ÷ 0.5

⇒ x = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method for Ages

When comparing ages across different times, the time gap corresponds to the change in ratio parts. Equating the ratio difference to the actual years gap provides the value of 1 ratio part directly.

Handling Percentages in Equations

If a value is P% more than a base value, it is equivalent to (100 + P)% of the base value. Here, 50% more implies 150% of the past age, giving a ratio of 150:100 or 3:2.

Linear Time Gaps

If the present age is x, then the age n years ago is (x − n), and the age m years hence is (x + m). The total time difference between these two points is always (n + m) years.
</p

questions.question: The ratio of the present age of a father to that of his son is 5 ∶ 2. After 5 years their ages will be in the ratio of 7 ∶ 3. The present age of the father is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of present age of father and son = 5 : 2

Ratio of their age after 5 years = 7 : 3

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of father and son be 5x and 2x respectively

Age of father 5 years later = 5x + 5

Age of son 5 years later = 2x + 5

Now, according to question

(5x + 5)/(2x + 5) = 7 : 3

⇒ 3(5x + 5) = 7(2x + 5)

⇒ 15x + 15 = 14x + 35

⇒ 15x + 14x = 35 - 15

⇒ x = 20

Age of father after 5 years = 5x = (5 × 20) = 100 years

**∴ The present age of the father is 100 years.**

questions.question: Eight years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 22 years. The average age of A and C after 2 years from now will be 32.5 years. What will be the age (in years) of B after 3 years from now?

⇒ Q = 29

Now, the age of B after 3 years

**∴ 32 years will be the age of B after 3 years from now.**

Average age after the baby is born = (80 + 0) / 5 = 16 years.

Ratio of present ages of B and C = 39/27 = 13 : 9
